ProfileSetting.name: settingId
ProfileSetting.description: Permanent progress is isolated by playerId and settingId; no implicit global profile.

referencedRules.description: Descriptive status, modifier and condensation-recipe references from the pinned revision. Does not execute effects.

version.description: Pinned content, composition and run/combat coordinates.

influences.description: Intrinsic card contribution components, including critical chance or multiplier changes that do not change composed-base numbers.

explanations.description: Per-parameter source attributes, eligible zero values, pertinent contributors, conditions and bounded bucket outputs. Full detail may include technical traces.

impacts.description: Separate target outcomes with captured-preview validity; never the face value.

CardScalingAttribute.description: Binding metadata, not an instruction to calculate gameplay on the client. Contribution is the value actually consumed by the canonical calculation.

instance.description: Owned unit identity, acquisition revision/source/sequence and Available/Consumed/Bound state, including card/transformation binding when used.

contributions.description: Bounded contribution facts in pipeline units, not full formulas, variables or historical state.

runDefinitionId.description: Published run definition; omitted selects default_run.

commandId.description: Creation retry key, scoped by player and setting. Same key requires identical inputs and returns original sequence-1 state; use a new key for a new attempt. Without a key, seeded requests retry by inputs; unseeded requests create new attempts.

contentRevision.description: Published content revision; omitted means the current revision.

attemptKey.description: Changes the deterministic identity of a new attempt.

type.description: Canonical command type. INVOKE_CARD_ZONE_GAMEPLAY_FLOW accepts a configured GameplayCommand flow with { flowId, cardInstanceIds?, requestedCount? }; it cannot create arbitrary card definitions or invoke Tool flows. ACTIVATE_CONTENT_REVISION accepts { revision } and is allowed only when the run's resolved GameMode enables versioned activation. START_DIALOGUE accepts { dialogueId }. CHOOSE_DIALOGUE_OPTION accepts { dialogueInstanceId, nodeId, choiceId }; choices are validated and committed atomically with costs, effects and narrative flags.

runResourceOwnerId.description: Owner of the resources wallet; not the character resource reserve.

progressProvenance.description: Monotonic recorded origin; disabling cheats never restores Published provenance.

items.description: Canonical grant with policy/content revision, command, evidence counts, contribution keys and targets

conditionSatisfied.description: Read-only explanation; never an implicit grant

profileRevision.description: Historical provenance, excluded from effective eligibility identity.

GameplayCardZoneFlowPayload.description: Only authored GameplayCommand flows can be invoked; selected instances must be visible to the player.

sequence.description: Root commit sequence for this receipt.

duplicate.description: True when the idempotency key returned a previously committed receipt.

costs.description: Canonical resolved costs for this candidate and cost option; do not recalculate in clients.

contentRevision.description: Immutable content revision pinned for this state.

engineVersion.description: Deterministic runtime version that interprets the revision.

playableCards.description: Cards in every authored zone that allows play for the active actor.

rootSequence.description: Authoritative run commit containing every frame produced by the command.

calculations.description: Bucket calculations used by effects in this frame.

applications.description: Concrete immutable mutations produced by the frame.

cardZoneSteps.description: Ordered, purpose-independent card-zone transitions produced by this command frame.

stateAfter.description: Present in FullSnapshots mode; null in compact mode.

snapshotSequence.description: Sequence accepted by GET /timeline/{sequence}/state for compact frame lookup.

identity.description: Stable execution/proc/impact IDs and parent coordinates

condensation.description: Captured source stacks, evaluation timing and aggregated quantities

continuation.description: Causal defeat, configured overflow calculation, visited targets and stop reason

CalculationTrace.description: Resolved calculation including ordered buckets, contributions and provenance.

resourceOutcome.description: Observed requested/applied/limited changes and causal defeat facts, not another damage formula

removedModifierInstanceIds.description: All modifier instances removed by this application, in deterministic order.

modifierStackChanges.description: Complete before/after stack trace for every affected modifier instance.

CardZoneFlowStepRecord.description: A single revisioned card-zone flow step, including ordering and deterministic state hashes.

resolutionCommandId.description: Use with GET /resolutions/{commandId}; null when the item has no visual resolution.

historicalInspectionAllowed.description: Effective mode/operator permission; false means only timeline headers are accessible.

version.description: Run, combat, engine and content-revision coordinates used by this projection

previewScope.description: Exact only for the captured snapshot, target IDs and cost option; dependsOnRandomInputs does not mean nondeterministic. GET never consumes RNG.

zone.description: Authored card-zone identifier containing this instance.

isPlayable.description: Includes card conditions, costs, targeting, active actor, phase and action budget.

contextSources.description: Pinned actor, targets, statuses, relics, modifiers and mode policies; present only at Full detail.

calculations.description: Configured bucket traces and influence provenance

previewSteps.description: Ordered effect trace produced by the same pure transaction used by PLAY_CARD

previewApplications.description: Exact immutable effect preview from the current deterministic snapshot

currentSequence.description: Authoritative sequence when a command conflicts

currentStep.description: Authoritative deterministic step when a command conflicts
